advisories.name: Mountain View Pond
advisories.detail: Mountain View Pond in Gardnerville, NV has been placed on a HAB Watch advisory as of 10/14/2026 following visual observation of a surface bloom. Hazardous conditions are possible or present. People and pets should use caution when in contact with water and avoid areas of algae accumulation.

advisories.name: Lahontan Reservoir
advisories.detail: As of 9/9/2026 the HAB Danger advisory continues at Lahontan Reservoir. In addition, the Nevada Division of State Parks (NDSP) has prohibited swimming for visitors and pets at the Silver Springs side of the reservoir due to elevated toxin levels. Stay out of the water! For the NDSP press release, click here.
